title: Free GTA 6 is a scam: how the trap works
yt_title: Want free GTA 6? It's a SCAM 🚨 How the trap works
description: Want free GTA 6? It's a scam that steals your Google login. Malwarebytes found a 'free copy' site that asks for an account check, then sends you to a fake Google sign-in page built to steal your login. There's no PC or mobile version of GTA 6 yet, and NordVPN even found GTA 6 scam kits sold on the dark web. Red flags: a free copy, an account check, a Google sign-in, or a PC download.
